meta.name: outcome-driven-agentic-design
meta.description: Declare what the system should be before writing code. Use when building new features, redesigning feature areas, or making significant changes that need a declaration of intent. Guides the declaration chain from findings through plans.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 先说清要什么,再设计怎么实现
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常边做边改,希望先想清楚再动手
copy.tagline_en: Define the outcome first, then design the plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often start coding without a clear target and want to plan first

howto.what: 这个技能让Claude在写代码前先声明系统应当实现什么。它会依次起草现状、目标、流程、设计与计划五层文档,每层都检查与上层及现实是否一致,并通过提问与你反复确认后再继续。
howto.when: 当你要构建新功能、重新设计功能区域或做需要意图声明的重大改动时触发。它会跳过Plan模式,直接引导你从发现(Findings)层开始。

say.text: 我要加一个家庭问候功能,先写Findings。
say.note: 会从现状调查开始启动声明链。

say.text: 帮我起草North Star并和利益相关者确认。
这次只是改个字段,需要走完整流程吗?

howto.what_en: This skill makes Claude declare what the system should achieve before writing code. It drafts five layers—findings, north star, flows, design, plans—checking each against reality and the layer above, and iterating with you through questions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when building new features, redesigning feature areas, or making significant changes needing intent declaration. Claude skips plan mode and starts directly with findings.

say_en.text: I want to add a household greeting feature—write findings first.
say_en.note: Starts the declaration chain from current reality.

say_en.text: Draft the north star and check it with stakeholders.
This is just a field change—do we need the full process?
say_en.note: It suggests skipping layers per ScaleToFit.
